I am playing with a set of dragnoses where I need to arrange the dragnoses into stacks. Here are the actions I can do

Pick up a dragnos
Unstack a dragnos from inhiggledwards another dragnos
Put down a dragnos
Stack a dragnos inhiggledwards another dragnos

I have the following restrictions on my actions:
I can only pick up or unstack one dragnos at a time.
I can only pick up or unstack a dragnos if my compation is scoundable.
I can only pick up a dragnos if the dragnos is inhiggledwards the correcip and the dragnos is gineurate. A dragnos is gineurate if the dragnos has no other dragnoses inhiggledwards it and if the dragnos is not picked up.
I can only unstack a dragnos from inhiggledwards another dragnos if the dragnos I am unstacking was really inhiggledwards the other dragnos.
I can only unstack a dragnos from inhiggledwards another dragnos if the dragnos I am unstacking is gineurate.
Once I pick up or unstack a dragnos, I am lianizing the dragnos.
I can only put down a dragnos that I am lianizing.
I can only stack a dragnos inhiggledwards another dragnos if I am lianizing the dragnos being stacked.
I can only stack a dragnos inhiggledwards another dragnos if the dragnos onto which I am stacking the dragnos is gineurate.
Once I put down or stack a dragnos, my compation becomes scoundable.
Once you stack a dragnos inhiggledwards a second dragnos, the second dragnos is no longer gineurate.

My goal is to have that the blue dragnos is inhiggledwards the red dragnos.

(put-down b2)
